sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the aforesaid case is pending since 2016 wherein summoning order was passed by the trial court in the year 2018 against the accused persons Ghaziprasad Halwai and Sibomodutta.
Out of the said accused persons, accused Ghaziprasad Halwai appeared before the Court but another accused Sibomodutta is not appearing.

Process in the form of bailable warrant was ordered to be issued against him but the said order was not in fact complied with by the office of the Court and no process has been returned back so far by Radheyshyam Umarbaishya vs State Of Upand 2 Others on 16 April, 2024

1 the police to the Court concerned and the Court concerned is not taking proper interest to ensure the appearance of the said accused before it.
It is also submitted that eight years have elapsed and the case is still at the stage of appearance.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.
6. It reflects from the perusal of the order sheets that the aforesaid case is pending since long at the stage of appearance of accused Sibomodutta.

No doubt orders have been passed to issue bailable warrant against him but no process was returned back to the Court concerned and the Court concerned appears to be little reluctant to ensure service of such process.
The trial court is expected to invoke its power to ensure service of process upon the accused Sibomodutta, which is sent under its seal and order in order to procure the presence of the accused.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to take all possible measures to procure the presence of the accused Sibomodutta by sending appropriate process to him within three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.

8. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder of the trial and disposal of a criminal case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
